meta.name: Jedi Labs public benchmarks
meta.description: Machine-readable benchmark numbers for Jedi Labs shipped model demos. Free to cite. Creative Commons BY 4.0.
meta.citation_hint: If you cite one of these numbers, cite https://jedilabs.org/benchmarks as the source and include the retrieval date.

benchmarks.value_note: Approximate; measured on Hugging Face Spaces free-tier cold start with ~150 MB model download.
benchmarks.dataset: Sampled video scenes (zero-shot, no training data)

steps.name: Assemble
steps.description: Pull the public validation/test cohort (e.g. ESC-50, chest X-ray, coastline imagery, sampled video). Freeze a versioned snapshot in the training repo. No proprietary data enters the public number.

steps.name: Train
steps.description: Run the training loop end-to-end with reproducible seed, published architecture, and checkpoint management. All code lives in the fjkiani GitHub org and the ai-training repo.

steps.name: Evaluate
steps.description: Compute the reported metric (accuracy / IoU / F1) against held-out validation or test data. Dual-axis loss curves and per-class F1 are logged for every training run.

steps.name: Ship
steps.description: Post the number here and on the corresponding Hugging Face Space with live inference. If the number moves, the Space moves. If the Space breaks, the number is retracted until it does not.
